name: web-astronaut-404-page-with-earth-horizon-and-wide-tracked-numerals
title: Black space 404 with a floating astronaut, big white numerals, a small message and an outlined home pill
whatItIs: A black space scene with a real photo of an astronaut floating at left, the Earth's curved edge along the bottom, a white 'Oops!' and giant wide-tracked '404', two lines of message and an outlined 'Back to home' pill.
whatItMeans: Vast and witty; being lost in space matches a lost page.
techniques: Use a floating astronaut as a metaphor for lost.
Set numerals in wide light letters.

vocabulary.definition: Using space imagery to express being lost.
The curved planet edge along the bottom.
A capsule with a border only.
